items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: I first saw Louis Jordan, he was playing with the Rabbit Foot Minstrel.

ctx.x: Well, Lewis Jordan and I were around about the same age. Louis Jordan -- I first saw Louis Jordan, he was playing with the Rabbit Foot Minstrel. He was one of the greatest -- he was one of the most exciting musicians I had ever heard at that time. He played the clarinet and the soprano saxophone. Well, the soprano saxophone was rather a new instrument, you know, back in that time. And Louis Jordan could play both instruments, the clarinet and the soprano saxo-

phone. I mean when he would take that saxophone and put it up in the air, the people would just scream. The people just went crazy. He was an artist. He always has been an artist. He was born in Brinkley, Arkansas.
